summary.text: Shirley Aldebol represents the 13th District on the New York City Council in the East Bronx, which includes Pelham Parkway, Morris Park, Throggs Neck and City Island.
Her Council biography says she spent over 35 years as an organizer and leader in the labor movement, including 20 years as Executive Vice President of Local 32BJ SEIU.

paragraphs.text: Aldebol was born and raised in the Bronx to parents who migrated from Puerto Rico and grew up working at her family's bodega in Soundview, according to her Council biography.
Her parents bought a home in Throggs Neck, and she later bought a home there and raised her son, Emilio, as a single mother.

She began as a child welfare caseworker, where she got involved with her union, and later organized workers including public employees seeking collective bargaining rights in Puerto Rico and school cleaners seeking the prevailing wage in New York City.
